games:2026-wk10-miami-notre-dame.blurb: No. 1 Miami heads to South Bend as a touchdown underdog to No. 11 Notre Dame, with ESPN's model giving the Irish a 61% shot at home. A 56.5 total suggests points, and the Hurricanes' hold on the top spot is the first thing on the line.

games:2026-wk10-alabama-lsu.blurb: No. 5 Alabama visits No. 14 LSU in a rivalry night game with the Tide catching 5.5 in Baton Rouge. ESPN leans LSU at 57%, and with a 52.5 total this one profiles as a grinder where one possession decides the SEC pecking order.

games:2026-wk10-byu-utah.blurb: No. 9 BYU and No. 3 Utah renew the rivalry with the Big 12's playoff hierarchy hanging on it, Utah favored by 5.5 at home. The 48.5 total is the lowest among the day's headliners, and ESPN gives the Utes a 66% edge.

games:2026-wk10-kentucky-tennessee.blurb: No. 6 Kentucky walks into Neyland as a 6.5-point underdog to No. 13 Tennessee, with ESPN giving the Vols a 67% chance. The Wildcats' rise up the poll gets its stiffest road test yet.

games:2026-wk10-oregon-ohio-state.blurb: No. 23 Oregon draws No. 12 Ohio State in Columbus as a 7.5-point dog, and ESPN pegs the Buckeyes at 83% in a game with a modest 46.5 total. Ohio State needs the result far more than the number suggests.

games:2026-wk10-georgia-ole-miss.blurb: No. 2 Georgia is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against No. 10 Ole Miss, one of the few spots all year the Bulldogs are close to a coin flip (55.5% per ESPN). A 56.5 total points to a shootout in Oxford with SEC positioning on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-missouri.blurb: No. 7 Texas is a field goal better than No. 18 Missouri on the road, though ESPN's model is far more bullish at 71% for the Longhorns. The 42.5 total says both defenses are expected to show up.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-cincinnati-hou.blurb: No. 17 Houston lays 10.5 at home against Cincinnati with an inflated 62.5 total, and ESPN gives the Cougars an 84% shot. A ranked team with no margin for error facing a get-right number.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-ucla-minnesota.blurb: No. 8 UCLA goes to Minnesota favored by 5.5 in a game with a 39.5 total, the lowest on the board. ESPN gives the Bruins a 68% chance, but this is the kind of grind-it-out road trip that trips up playoff hopefuls.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 15 Texas Tech is a 17.5-point home favorite over West Virginia with a 65.5 total, and ESPN has the Red Raiders at 89%. Style points matter here more than the win does.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oklahoma-flori.blurb: No. 24 Florida hosts Oklahoma as a 6.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Gators a 64% edge and the total set at 44.5. Florida's grip on a poll spot is the subplot.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-iowa-northwest.blurb: No. 19 Iowa is a rare ranked road underdog, getting three at Northwestern in a game with a 45.5 total. ESPN still calls it close to even at 55-45 for the Wildcats.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-merrimack-wake.blurb: No. 16 Wake Forest hosts Merrimack in a no-line tune-up. The only real risk for the Demon Deacons is leaving town healthy and unbothered.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 25 Boise State is a 17.5-point favorite at Colorado State with a 68.5 total, and ESPN gives the Broncos a 93% chance. Anything less than a comfortable win would cost them in the poll.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-tcu-arizona.blurb: No. 22 Arizona opens the weekend at home against TCU as an 8.5-point favorite, with ESPN at 74% for the Wildcats. A 44.5 total frames it as a defensive evening in Tucson.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-a-m-sout.blurb: No. 21 South Carolina lays seven at home to Texas A&M, but ESPN sees it much tighter at 54-46. The 51.5 total hints at a game decided late.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: A brutal tumble from No. 2 to No. 12 in the poll, but the computers never flinched: Ohio State is No. 1 in SP+ and No. 2 in FPI. Expect the voters to come back around quickly.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky has climbed to No. 6 after sitting ninth, yet the models are deeply skeptical -- 31st in SP+ and 26th in FPI. That gap is the widest on the board and it gets stress-tested in Knoxville.

predictions:notre-dame.blurb: The Irish slid from No. 5 to No. 11 in the poll while remaining No. 1 in FPI and No. 3 in SP+. By the numbers they're still a top-three team hosting the No. 1 team in the country.

predictions:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest dipped two spots to No. 16, and the metrics are split -- 11th in FPI but only 25th in SP+. The ACC race will settle which number is telling the truth.

predictions:utah.blurb: Utah jumped to No. 3 from sixth, well ahead of where the models have them at 10th in both SP+ and FPI. Beating BYU at home would start closing that gap.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia at No. 2 leads the SEC's auto-bid chase with No. 5 Alabama three spots back -- close enough that one Saturday flips it. Both are on the road this week against ranked opposition.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: No. 4 Indiana sits atop the Big Ten's auto-bid race with No. 8 UCLA four spots behind. The Bruins can tighten it with a road win at Minnesota.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 3 Utah holds a six-spot cushion over No. 9 BYU in the Big 12 race -- and the two meet head-to-head this week. A BYU win in Salt Lake City would erase the gap in a hurry.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State sits at the 13 seed, one spot outside the field after a 10-spot plunge. Hosting No. 23 Oregon is a chance to stop the slide immediately.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU nudged up a spot to the 15 seed but remains three out of the field. A home date with No. 5 Alabama is exactly the résumé swing they need.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech slipped two spots to the 16 seed, four away from the field, and doesn't have a ranked opponent on deck to make up ground. Margin may have to do the talking.

bubbleNotes:tennessee.blurb: Tennessee climbed three spots to the 14 seed, now just two out of the field. Beat No. 6 Kentucky at home and the Vols are squarely back in the conversation.
